dedupe_keys.name: threat landscape for vital infrastructure 2025 nctv netherlands

description: The Dreigingslandschap Vitale Infrastructuur, published by the Dutch National Coordinator for Security and Counterterrorism on 23 July 2025, is the first threat landscape for Dutch vital infrastructure. It gives an overview of the main threats to vital infrastructure and of recent developments in those threats, and offers sector ministries and vital providers a frame of thinking to understand, for their specific vital processes, the threats, the resilience, the security interests affected by disruption or failure, and the resulting risks to national security. The NCTV presents it as a starting point for the risk and resilience analyses of vital processes to be made in the vital infrastructure cycle and under the Dutch act on the resilience of critical entities (Wwke), which implements the EU Critical Entities Resilience Directive. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0 (NCTV: website content under CC0 unless stated otherwise). Access is free of charge. Caveats: it is a qualitative threat assessment in Dutch, not a dataset of incidents or assets. Coverage is the Netherlands. It supports scenario design for cascading failure and security threat analysis of energy, water, telecom, transport and other vital processes; related records are the Ireland National Risk Assessment 2023 and the UK National Risk Register 2025.
